lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Spot size and inter-centroid distance increase moving towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary spots, forming a regular grid-like pattern where nodes of maximum intensity reside within the vertical light bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient running parallel to the horizontal axis of the animal.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to and swimming in close proximity to the ventral area and the base of the pectoral fin.
